role: Feature acceptance consistency: implementation versus public README claims and requirements ledger

scope.application_commit_reviewed: e625ee7 with concurrent working-tree fixes; audit distinguishes public RC5 snapshot from unreleased code12 preparation
additional_read: AdvancedScreens.kt BatchEntry/BatchInput, complete LibraryPreferences, complete OfflinePreview and PrivacyScreen composables

Previously completed full reads of MainActivity/MainViewModel/Models, DirectDownloader/ParallelDownloader/MediaEngine/NativeProcessSession, DownloadService/DownloadQueue, BatchDraft/PrivateJournal/TaskTimeline, OutputStore/TransferProcessor/PublicationReceipt, LibraryRepository, manifests and app Gradle config
AppRoot startup, paste/share, enqueue/queue, destination picker and library action wiring
scope.method: Read-only source/document consistency audit, not end-to-end product acceptance. No source/test/build edits, builds, test execution, device interaction or publication.

claim_checks.claim: Paste/share public links and choose actual available formats
claim_checks.assessment: Source implemented; source availability remains conditional
evidence: MainActivity receives SEND text/plain, MainViewModel validates/analyzes links and retains incoming shares while busy.
MediaEngine filters metadata formats and DRM, returns source-derived choices and uses literal format IDs. ChoiceSelection preserves selected container/language while changing quality.

claim_checks.claim: MP3 V0 extraction and compatible video merging
claim_checks.assessment: Source implemented with explicit conversion/original distinction
evidence: MediaEngine requests extract-audio/audio-format mp3/audio-quality 0 for MP3 audio choices and merge-output-format for paired formats.
Converted audio choices omit estimated output size/bitrate; unchanged MP3 uses Original labeling. MP3_ACCEPTANCE explicitly avoids promising improved source quality or fixed bitrate/size.

claim_checks.claim: Direct files without a fixed size cap; validator-bound resume
evidence: DirectDownloader uses Long counters and strong validator/target/Content-Range checks for append; StoragePolicy reserves space without a media-size ceiling.
README and ledger distinguish direct validated resume from native extraction restart.

claim_checks.claim: Durable queue, priorities, retry, up to20 links with per-row format/folder and encrypted draft recovery
claim_checks.assessment: Source implemented; one active-file ownership is deliberate
evidence: DownloadQueue journals waiting/active tasks and uses priority ordering; BatchInput caps20 rows and BatchDraft persists encrypted row/choice/destination/delivery identities.
MainViewModel serializes draft handoff with durable queue acceptance receipts; source has explicit retry/storage-error gates.

claim_checks.claim: Hash-verified publication and recovery across supported destination interruptions
claim_checks.assessment: Source implemented with recovery limits disclosed
evidence: OutputStore compares source/destination fingerprints; PublicationReceipt records a plan before creation and verified state before publish.

README/ledger qualify supported interruptions/providers and instruct same-task retry; they do not claim all-provider transactionality. Existing reviewer08 rename-durability residual is not duplicated here.

claim_checks.claim: Search/filter/preview library and distinguish missing/denied/unavailable storage
claim_checks.assessment: Source implemented; codec/provider matrix remains open
evidence: LibraryScreens filters name/MIME/category/group/size and sorts; FileAccess maps permission failures separately and treats ambiguous remote emptiness as unavailable.
OfflinePreview opens content URIs and pauses on lifecycle PAUSE/STOP; ledger explicitly leaves codec/corrupt-media/physical-provider matrices open.

claim_checks.claim: Bounded encrypted task timeline with no source names/credentials
evidence: TaskTimeline accepts typed IDs/stages/results/bytes/codes, bounds32 tasks and24 events/task, and writes through PrivateJournal.
Retention is applied when timeline is used; ledger separately labels ordinary completed-history duration as a display filter.

claim_checks.claim: Arabic RTL, English, Tajawal, dark UI; no ads/analytics/background clipboard monitor
claim_checks.assessment: Source supports selected claims; no external certification inferred
evidence: Arabic/English resources, MainActivity locale handling, manifest supportsRtl and Tajawal fonts/dark scheme are present.
Read source/dependency wiring contains explicit user-driven Paste and clipboard-write actions; no account/ad/analytics flow is exposed in the inspected app sources.

claim_checks.claim: Single universal Android10+ artifact and no first-use engine download
claim_checks.assessment: Source configuration supports minSdk29/four ABIs and bundled initialization; exact release artifact requires separate verification
evidence: app Gradle minSdk29 and default ARM32/ARM64/x86/x86_64 filters support the documented target.

EngineRuntime installs bundled components; CHECKPOINT marks code12 unreleased and keeps public RC5 as a separately verified historical artifact. This review did not inspect/re-download or run the final APK.

explicitly_open_requirements: OS-backed deferred scheduling, multiple simultaneous active files and subtitle selection are expressly listed as unimplemented in both READMEs/ledger/checkpoint; their absence is not a new defect.
Physical Samsung/other-device behavior, long idle/battery/CPU/memory measurements, actual Wi-Fi/cellular handover, real ENOSPC and broad storage-provider/codec coverage remain unverified.
Exact native/transitive source correspondence and physical16KB execution remain bounded evidence questions; source-level features do not close them.
limitations: No README historical test result or public artifact hash was independently reproduced in this review.
Current README/VERIFICATION describe RC5 while CHECKPOINT explicitly describes the unreleased code12 branch; this separation is not treated as a stale-version defect.
Feature presence is supported by source paths, not a claim that every endpoint/device/provider passes acceptance.
Maximum-two finding cap yielded zero new proven actionable claim/implementation mismatches. Concurrent edits may change the final tree.
